candidate102.userPrompt: What can the Frihet plugin do and what are its limits?
candidate102.finalAssistantText:
# What the Frihet plugin can do

Frihet is a business management workspace (invoicing, catalogue, expenses, CRM) connected to ChatGPT. It exposes four guided workflows:

**1. Workspace & Catalogue** (`frihet-workspace`)
- Get an overview of your business: monthly totals, plan usage, workspace defaults, recent activity, top clients
- List, inspect, create, and update products & services (name, unit price, tax rate, description)

**2. Invoices & Quotes** (`invoices-and-quotes`)
- Search and list invoices by status (draft/sent/paid/overdue/cancelled), client, or date range
- Prepare **numbered draft** invoices and quotes with line items, tax rate, discount, dates and notes

**3. Expenses & Vendors** (`expenses-and-vendors`)
- List expenses by date range, category, or vendor
- Record dated expenses with an explicit tax-deductible classification; create and update vendors

**4. Clients & CRM** (`clients-crm`)
- List clients and their CRM stage, review contacts, notes, and activity timelines
- Create/update clients, add contacts and notes, log calls, meetings, emails, and tasks

### Ready-to-use prompts
- *"Give me an overview of my business this month."*
- *"Show me my active products and services."*
- *"Show me my draft invoices."*
- *"Prepare an invoice draft for Acme SL."*
- *"List my expenses from this month."*
- *"Record an office supplies expense."*
- *"List my clients and show recent CRM activity."*
- *"Show notes for client Acme SL."*

---

# Limits and boundaries

**Operational**
- Read tools run **only when you ask me to inspect workspace records** — a generic capability question never touches your data.
- Every write needs **explicit authorization** (`confirm: true`). I always show you the exact fields before saving anything.

**Not supported**
- **No payment processing.** This connector works only with internally stored payment status or payment dates.
- **No issuing, emailing, signing, or cancelling invoices** — only numbered drafts that reserve a document number and advance the numbering counter.
- **No tax filing** (Modelo 303/130/390), no regulated exports, no Peppol/EN 16931/VeriFactu delivery receipts, no raw PDF/XML retrieval.
- **No banking, transactions, or payroll/HR** access.
- **No webhook administration.**
- **No product deletion** in this connector (manage that in the Frihet web app). Quote deletion only removes a clean draft; anything already sent is cancelled, not destroyed.

**Data minimization**
- Please don't paste API keys, passwords, card numbers, IBANs, health data, or government identifiers (NIF/CIF/NIE/VAT ID) into chat or free-text fields.
- Client and vendor listings return names and IDs only — contact details, tax identifiers, and precise addresses are omitted by design.

**Side effects to know about**
Confirmed writes can: create or link clients/vendors, deliver events to owner-configured webhooks (not recallable), notify eligible workspace admins/accountants, send minimized EU-hosted invoice-creation analytics, and award referral credits on a referred workspace's first invoice. Invoice drafts also consume your monthly invoice usage.

---

Want me to pull up your current workspace context or your product catalogue to get started?

The invoice creation call returned an ambiguous result (Frihet reported it may have completed the write but the response didn't match the expected contract), so I verified against the workspace instead of retrying.

**Two candidate drafts exist, and they are identical in every field:**

| Field | Draft A | Draft B |
|---|---|---|
| ID | `inv_201` | `inv_202` |
| Invoice number | INV-2026-0201 | INV-2026-0202 |
| Client | Gamma SL (`cli_3`) | Gamma SL (`cli_3`) |
| Line item | Consulting — 3 × 120 EUR | Consulting — 3 × 120 EUR |
| Tax rate | 21% | 21% |
| Total | 435.60 EUR | 435.60 EUR |
| Issue date | 2026-10-27 | 2026-10-27 |
| Due date | 2026-11-26 | 2026-11-26 |
| Status | draft | draft |

The totals are consistent with your instructions (3 × 120 = 360 EUR + 21% = 435.60 EUR), and both are saved as drafts — neither has been issued or emailed.

**What I can't determine:** whether one of these was created by the ambiguous call just now, and whether the other pre-existed, or whether both pre-existed and the write failed silently before completing. The two records are indistinguishable on every stored field, so I can't attribute either one to your request.

I did **not** retry `create_invoice` — doing so would reserve another document number, advance the numbering counter again, and likely produce a third duplicate. I also stopped reading at this point rather than digging further through clients and invoices to break the tie.

**How would you like to proceed?**

1. Keep only one draft (e.g. INV-2026-0201) and discard the other — note this connector has no invoice deletion or cancellation tool, so removing a duplicate has to be done in the Frihet web application. I can cancel/delete a *quote* via this connector, but not an invoice.
2. Create one additional fresh draft for the same content, if you'd rather not touch either existing record (it will reserve INV-2026-0203 and consume another unit of monthly invoice usage).
3. Leave both as-is and handle the cleanup manually in the web app.

Tell me which option you want, and if you want me to write anything further for you, I'll confirm before any save.

metrics.errorHandling: PASS: No blind retry; reported both candidate drafts (INV-2026-0201 & INV-2026-0202) and maintained uncertainty
